concept: CloudFront: CDN caching at the edge
tests: Choosing a service to cache static and dynamic content close to users and reduce origin load.
expected: Amazon CloudFront caches at edge locations worldwide. Triggers: "cache content close to users", "reduce origin load", "global", "static and dynamic".
why_not: Global Accelerator speeds up the network path but does not cache; Route 53 only routes; an ALB in one region — no edge.
